lead: Your past purchases and buying rules, in one place. Import the purchase records you already keep (Excel or CSV exports from your ERP or ledger). From then on, every request shows what you paid before, to whom and when, and whoever sources for you works to your own criteria. The data stays inside your organisation.

import.heading: Import purchase records
import.hint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, and also PDF and scans or photos of paper slips and FAXes (PNG, JPEG, TIFF; up to 10 pages). Japanese or English headings, Shift_JIS or UTF-8. Nothing is stored until you press Import. Rows that cannot be read exactly are not guessed: they are left out and listed.
import.currency: Currency when a row has none
import.ocrNotice: This scan or FAX was read by text recognition (OCR) on our own server; nothing was sent outside. Check every date, quantity, price and part number against the paper. Rows with a number the OCR was unsure of have been left out.

preview.columns: Columns: check what each column holds
preview.sample: First rows as they will be stored

reason.item_missing: No item name or part number

search.heading: Past purchases
search.placeholder: Item, part number, maker or supplier

derived: Worked out from the amount and quantity

criteria.heading: Buying criteria
criteria.hint: How your company decides. Shown to whoever sources each request, so they choose the way you would.
criteria.excluded: Suppliers not to use (one per line)
criteria.alert: Flag quotes above the last price by (%)

reference.heading: Decision material
reference.none: No past purchases match these items yet. Import your purchase records under Purchase history.
reference.on_alias: matched through an item confirmed as the same

similar.none: No similar past items were found.

aliases.heading: Same items (aliases)
aliases.hint: The same item written differently (e.g. 6204ZZ and 6204-2Z). Once confirmed, the decision material and the quote comparison treat them as one item. Candidates are only proposed by how alike the text looks; a person always confirms.

opportunities.heading: Where you can save
opportunities.hint: From your own purchase records: what was paid above the lowest price you already got for the same item. Items always bought from one supplier were never compared, so no amount is shown for them; they are the first to ask other suppliers about.
opportunities.none: No purchase records in this period.
opportunities.singleSupplier: Always the same supplier: never compared
